definitions.explanation: A system where customers serve themselves rather than being served by staff. Common in gas stations, restaurants, and stores.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}はセルフサービスです。
セルフサービスのガソリンスタンドで{給油|きゅうゆ}した。
examples.english: I filled up at a self-service gas station.

examples.japanese: {食堂|しょくどう}はセルフサービスなので、{自分|じぶん}でトレーを{片付|かたづ}けてください。
examples.english: The cafeteria is self-service, so please put away your own tray.

notes:
セルフサービス describes a system where customers serve themselves instead of being waited on by staff. From English "self-service."

FORMS:
Often shortened to セルフ in casual speech: セルフのガソリンスタンド (self-service gas station), セルフレジ (self-checkout).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セルフサービスの{店|みせ}: self-service shop
- セルフサービス{方式|ほうしき}: self-service system
- セルフサービスのレジ / セルフレジ: self-checkout register
- セルフサービスの{食堂|しょくどう}: self-service cafeteria

USAGE:
- ガソリンスタンド: gas stations (increasingly common since 1998)
- {食堂|しょくどう} / カフェテリア: cafeterias
- ドリンクバー: drink bar (self-service drink station at restaurants)
- セルフうどん: self-service udon shops (popular in {讃岐|さぬき})

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can be used as a no-adjective: セルフサービスの{店|みせ} (a self-service shop).
